notes.title: Ballistick (Or was it Ball Stick?) Fixes
notes.content:
Hey all,

Fixed a couple of bugs concerning the achievements with Ballistick. If you were having trouble unlocking some in the past, you should be good to go. Also fixed how some of the achievements were listed. Big thanks to THE TENTH, ANZ, and Ambiguous Assassin for catching these. 

Happy hunting!

-Owen
